source.name: Toyota Warranty and Maintenance Guide
source.note: Read from the maintenance chart in Toyota's guide for these model years, in Glovebox's wording. Check it against the guide that came with your own vehicle.
source.basis: The mileages, months and jobs of the maintenance chart in Toyota's own Warranty and Maintenance Guides, which Toyota publishes free: T-MMS-25Tundra and T-MMS-26Tundra. Only those facts are taken; jobs are named in Glovebox's words and no text or layout is copied.
